brief.zh: 不用假设框，什么已知都没有，证出「下雨 → 下雨」。
brief.en: Without the assumption box and with nothing given, prove “it rains → it rains”.

hint.zh: S 的三句选「下雨」「下雨 → 下雨」「下雨」。它要的两句都能用 K 造。
hint.en: Choose “it rains”, “it rains → it rains”, “it rains” on S. Both sentences it then needs can be made with K.

hint.zh: 一块 K（「下雨」「下雨 → 下雨」）接 S 之后的第一次套用；另一块 K（两句都是「下雨」）接第二次。
hint.en: One K (“it rains”, “it rains → it rains”) into the first Apply after S; another K (both “it rains”) into the second.

t.zh: 有框的话，这是一个空框：假设「下雨」，直接把假设接到结论。没有框，只能从 K 和 S 拼。S 的第二句选什么，是这一关的关键。
t.en: With a box this is an empty box: assume “it rains” and wire the assumption straight to the conclusion. Without one, it has to be pieced together from K and S, and the key is S’s second sentence.

after.zh: 一句一眼就对的话，没有框也得用 K 和 S 拼出来。
after.en: Even a plainly true sentence has to be pieced together from K and S without a box.
